The compressor is a compact, high work-factor centrifugal compressor.
The design speed is 21,789 rpm, corrected to inlet conditions.
The impeller exit speed is 1615 ft/s.
The maximum tip clearance at the impeller trailing edge is 0.012 in.
The backplate leakage flow is controlled through the use of buffer air injected into the center of a multi-row labyrinth seal.
The uncertainty of the orifice-based mass flow measurement system is ± 0.1 lb/s.
The relative humidity range during the testing timeframe is 40 to 75 percent.
The uncertainty of the temperature measurements is ± 2.3 R for inlet conditions and ± 2.5 R for stage exit measurements.
The sampling rate of the data system is 1 Hz.
A minimum dwell time of 2 min is observed prior to data collection.
The compressor meets the goal-set for a new state-of-the-art centrifugal compressor.
The compressor achieves efficient pressure rise at low corrected flows and compact size.
The impeller has 15 main-blade/splitter-blade pairs with a spanwise varying backsweep between 32° to 42° from radial.
The vaned diffuser comprises 20 main/splitter vane pairs with the splitters slightly offset to maximize pressure recovery.
The EGV blade row comprises 60 cascade style airfoils.
